annotations.title: List AI subscription plans with list prices

description: Use when the user asks what AI plans cost (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, Copilot, Midjourney and others), or before aitab_total_ai_subscriptions to look up plan keys. Returns each service with its plans, USD monthly and yearly list prices and the key to pass on. Prices were checked on official pages and carry a checked date; plans marked estimate are unconfirmed. No input.
name: aitab_list_ai_plans
